text: {"final": {"verdict": "reject", "reason": "The best_route facts are correct (tie-break is (km, id); RT-02 over RT-03 for SITE-NVL-B, RT-05 over RT-06 for SITE-CPL-B, RT-07 over RT-08 for SITE-HGL-A), but the conclusion that SITE-NVL-B and SITE-HGL-A have no all-open route is false. Per data/network.json, RT-03 (SITE-NVL-B) uses R-04 and R-05, both status 'A', and RT-08 (SITE-HGL-A) uses R-10 and R-11, both 'A'. So passable_route would return (RT-03, truck) and (RT-08, truck) for those sites, not None. Only SITE-CPL-B has no all-open route (its alternative RT-06 uses R-09, status 'R'). The finding's own road listings contradict its conclusion."}}
reasoning:
Check the finding's claims:

- best_route tie-break (km, id): yes, min key is (r["km"], r["id"]).
- SITE-NVL-B: RT-02 (22 km, R-01+R-03, R-03 restricted) vs RT-03 (31 km, R-04+R-05 both A). best_route picks RT-02. ✓
- SITE-CPL-B: RT-05 (18 km, R-07 A + R-08 X) vs RT-06 (26 km, R-07 + R-09 R). Picks RT-05. ✓
- SITE-HGL-A: RT-07 (20 km, R-10 A + R-12 X) vs RT-08 (27 km, R-10+R-11 both A). Picks RT-07. ✓

Wait — the finding says "for SITE-HGL-A it picks RT-07 (20 km, R-12 closed) over RT-08 (27 km, R-10+R-11 open)". But RT-08 is all-open! So SITE-HGL-A does have an all-open route (RT-08). The finding claims "SITE-NVL-B, SITE-CPL-B and SITE-HGL-A have no all-open route, so passable_route would return None for them". That's false for SITE-HGL-A: RT-08 has R-10 (A) and R-11 (A), both open. So passable_route would return (RT-08, truck) for SITE-HGL-A, not None.

Also SITE-CPL-B: RT-06 has R-09 restricted — no all-open route, correct. SITE-NVL-B: RT-03 all open (R-04, R-05 both A)! Wait, the finding says RT-03 is R-04+R-05 both open — so SITE-NVL-B DOES have an all-open route (RT-03). The finding contradicts itself: it says RT-03 roads are both open, then claims SITE-NVL-B has no all-open route. That's wrong. passable_route would return (RT-03, truck) for SITE-NVL-B.

So the last claim is false for both SITE-NVL-B and SITE-HGL-A. Only SITE-CPL-B has no all-open route (RT-06 has R-09 restricted). So the finding is wrong.

Also the claim about "R" semantics needing decision in can_pass — that's a reasonable point but the core factual claim is wrong.

Verdict: reject.
